data.verdict: ANALYTIC M-DICTIONARY PART 1 — the u=0 5_2 tower layer derived and certified OCR-free: (T1) H+ satisfies the (86) q-difference recurrence and H- its q->q^-1 extension recurrence to <1e-38 (defect >1e-6 under the E1-sign flip; s1 = +1 pinned; the extension identity thereby structurally certified); (T2) the k=2 constant slot is proven (86)- and det-invisible (column operation), so orthogonality is its only pin; (T3) EXACT rational-series derivation: every Theorem-11 bilinear carries only the SUM sigma_c = c+ + c-, and (92)-polynomiality DERIVES sigma_c = 1/4 - 6*E2hat — identically the printed -(1/6)E2 / -(1/12)E2 reading with standard E2 = 1 - 24*E2hat — and the (92) RHS = [[1,0,0],[0,0,1],[0,1,3-q^m]], all entries exact Laurent polynomials to O(q^24), held-out m=2 verified (q^m slot moves correctly); the (c+, c-) split is Theorem-11-invisible and its pin is deferred honestly to the (82) state-integral match; (T4) independent mpmath implementation reproduces the derived identity to 1.07e-50. Foundation set for part 2: the W_-1-based (94)-(95) M/S sandwiches vs the q->0 targets (96/97, constants 3,4), then wall-crossing to deformed x for the derived phi_odd. No fit; no c_k wired; scope-(a).
